approval.approvalContext: The authenticated user authorized one collision-free six-frame successor to the immutable Seojin attack v1. This decision changes only the attack motion cadence and six ordered key poses, reuses v10 as the identity, appearance and equipment authority, and keeps the approved fast-preview PNG visual-reference-only. All earlier decisions, planning handoffs, routing, prompts and media remain immutable.

seojin.attack.allowed_vertical_motion.v1.value: none; preserve the support-foot ground axis across the draw, slash, and settle

seojin.attack.dark_neutral_ink_trajector.value: Use one bounded dark-neutral trajectory only at the frame-4 slash peak, subordinate to the identity contour and continuous sword path; no arbitrary speed lines, aura, magic trail, or magic VFX.

value.policy: Preserve body proportion, face, clothing, armor, sword and scabbard identity while the six frames follow one continuous root, hip, shoulder and blade trajectory with no pose duplication.

seojin.attack.hem_inertia.v12.value: The dusty gray-brown travel-robe hem drags behind the accelerating torso and blade, reaches its lag after the frame-4 peak, and settles through frames 5 and 6 without becoming a separate effect.

value.pose: Low compressed anticipation: center of mass drops, compact limbs coil, right hand stays on the left-waist hwando hilt, and the support-foot ground axis remains fixed.
Lead-foot drive and pelvis coil: the body begins forward drive while the left-waist scabbard counter-rotates against the winding torso.
Blade clearance and unwind start: the hwando clears the scabbard, shoulders and torso begin the single continuous diagonal release, and acceleration becomes visible.
Slash peak: the widest silhouette, strongest diagonal blade arc, foot pivot, weight shift and maximum torso rotation coincide at the action apex.
Overshoot and lag: the blade passes the apex once while one-shoulder armor, robe hem and gray-brown pigment flow follow one beat behind.
Controlled recovery and settle: torso and blade decelerate into a stable next-action-ready stance while identity, equipment and ground relationship remain continuous.

seojin.attack.motion_direction.v12.value: One right-handed draw-to-slash action follows a continuous low anticipation, forward drive, pelvis coil, blade clearance, torso unwind, diagonal peak, overshoot and controlled recovery; acceleration reads from frames 2 through 4, peaks at frame 4, and decelerates through frames 5 and 6.

value: Do not create move, idle, eight-way, rotation, pose-list, variant, another attack, or any batch beyond this one six-frame attack animation.
Do not treat the frames as unrelated pose thumbnails; root, hips, shoulders, sword, scabbard and garment flow must remain one continuous action.
Do not use arbitrary speed lines, decorative motion streaks, aura, magic trail, or magic VFX.
Do not use clean-vector, uniform closed-outline, coloring-book, photorealistic, 3D, PBR, or glossy cinematic treatment.
Do not add armor plates, scales, rivets, lacing, fasteners, garment microfolds, or material microtexture.
Do not drift body proportions, face, low topknot, costume layers, one-shoulder armor, hand-to-sword relation, hwando structure, left-waist scabbard, support foot, or action joints.
Do not treat the reviewed fast-preview PNG as person identity, canonical identity, clothing or equipment authority, or edit target.
Show exactly one right-handed six-frame attack continuing from the low draw anticipation at the left waist through one diagonal sword slash and controlled recovery.

Maintain the 4.25-head compact young-adult Korean male silhouette, face, low Joseon topknot, Joseon clothing, simplified one-shoulder armor, hwando and left-waist scabbard continuously across all six frames.
Read one continuous root, hip, shoulder, wrist, blade-tip and garment-flow trajectory rather than six unrelated poses.
Accelerate visibly from frames 2 through 4, reach the widest silhouette and strongest diagonal slash at frame 4, then decelerate through frames 5 and 6.
Use open and broken pressure-variable ink lines with broad rough watercolor and pastel bleed and generous negative space.
Integrate faded-indigo sword and torso directional pigment with the blade arc and torso unwind, and use dusty gray-brown shoulder and hem lag through overshoot and settle.
Use one bounded dark-neutral trajectory only at the frame-4 slash peak, subordinate to the identity contour.
Keep armor as one simplified shoulder mass without plate-level microdetail, and keep every frame on the same fixed canvas, scale, pelvis/root anchor and ground-contact axis.

seojin.attack.scale_lock.v12.value: constant subject scale, fixed 1024x1536 cell, no per-frame crop, rescale, silhouette recenter, or canvas change

seojin.attack.shoulder_inertia.v12.value: The simplified dusty gray-brown one-shoulder armor mass follows the torso rotation with a one-frame lag at frame 5 and settles at frame 6 without plate, scale, rivet, or material microdetail.

seojin.attack.sword_arc.v12.value: A single continuous hwando trajectory begins at the left-waist draw, clears the scabbard during torso unwind, reaches its widest strong diagonal apex at frame 4, overshoots once at frame 5, and settles without a second strike at frame 6.

seojin.attack.torso_rotation.v12.value: Torso and pelvis coil low, unwind progressively with lead-foot drive, reach maximum twist and weight transfer at frame 4, then decelerate through overshoot and recovery without reversing into another attack.
